periods.time: During the raid on Dragunov's Shinjuku underground arena
periods.label: 立体高速移动的恋恋

status.current: helps destroy Dragunov's underground arena and recapture escaped criminals
status.condition: shows a new three-dimensional Mach movement technique

periods.summary: Renren joins Hagun students in raiding Dragunov's illegal underground Blazer arena. She announces their special-conscription authority and uses Mach Greed to scatter masses of fighters with sonic booms. Against arena champion Queen, whose twin shields and advance knowledge counter her old linear attacks, Renren reveals Delta Force: a new three-dimensional high-speed movement pattern that lets her run across walls and ceilings and strike from any angle, defeating Queen from above.

key_events.summary: Defeats Queen and clears large numbers of arena fighters with high-speed movement.
